query: /horizons refresh Meridian using prior-artifact.html and the supplied tracker export. Delivery status only; do not regrade or publish. Keep changes local.
gap: Automatic assessed-refresh behavior can expand an explicit delivery-only request into a grade run or repeat questions the user already answered.
expected_behavior: Reads the specified existing artifact and tracker and reconciles the linked delivery records.
Keeps the historical grades and dates unchanged and labels grading as not reassessed.
Updates the same local entry file with source-backed delivery status, preserving baseline history.
Honors the explicit local-only scope without asking again whether grading or publishing is wanted.
must_not: Run a code audit or runtime probes for the delivery-only request.
Publish, create a sibling artifact or change the baseline.
Move existing horizons, add roadmap initiatives or reinterpret Backlog as a placement during a delivery-only refresh.
